name: Inmarsat
description: 14+ geostationary satellites providing maritime, aviation, and remote-area voice + data comms. Backbone of GMDSS — the Global Maritime Distress and Safety System every ocean-going vessel depends on. Acquired by Viasat in 2023.
scale_fact: Originally founded 1979 as an intergovernmental treaty body — older than the internet and one of the rare comms constellations that's been continuously upgraded since.
